description: k5 baseline (e5b_retrieval_k5_v2_merged_detvg_20260725) + zero-damage empty/error trigger: for the 25 dev questions where the k5 SQL returns an empty result or fails to execute, replace with the ORM-v2 band-selected (delta=0.1, result-hash group size tie-break) candidate from the merged 4-model n4 pool (agentar/omnisql/omnisql-921/qwen3). Trigger is oracle-free: empty k5 result never occurs on correct dev questions (0/1324), so replacement cannot damage a correct answer.

models.generator_baseline: GLM-5.2 API (cot8k retrieval k5 v2, detvg selector) — frozen from baseline run
models.orm: qwen3-14b-orm-v2-merged-bf16 (LoRA v2 merged, trained on train-split candidate results only)
models.candidate_pool: upstream merged4model n4 (train-split generated candidates, pre-existing)

inference.orm_backend: vLLM (vllm-cuda env), bf16, max_model_len=4096, prefix caching on, eager
inference.scoring: P(True) from first generated token logprobs (top-10), temperature=0, max_tokens=1

data.orm_training_data: train-split candidate files with execution-verified labels (upstream experiments)
